name: XDM (Xtreme Download Manager)
description: ServerCertificateCustomValidationCallback => true kills all cert validation; bundled yt-dlp updater downloads+chmod+x with zero verification → MitM→RCE. [Opus-verified: CONFIRMED-D]
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: The shared HTTP clients disable certificate validation globally, and the component updater handles the yt-dlp release in the application directory. The retained source supports this component updater channel; the app-level browser-only update is separate.
limitations: Review is limited to the retained commit; it does not certify released artifacts or current upstream behavior.

original_evidence.text: | XDM / Xtreme Download Manager | github.com/subhra74/xdm | C#/.NET (WPF + GTK UI) | Y | app itself: chk automatic (5s after launch, then every 3h via `AppUpdater.QueryNewVersion`'s `Timer`) but notify + manual install (opens browser to download page); bundled yt-dlp "component": chk/dl/inst fully automatic, replacing the binary in `AppDir` with no user step beyond the update dialog | Y for the yt-dlp component (downloaded file is `File.Move`d into `AppDir`, `chmod +x`'d on Linux, and later executed by XDM as its downloader engine) | https (api.github.com, github.com/.../releases) but **TLS certificate validation is globally DISABLED** — `ServerCertificateCustomValidationCallback = (a,b,c,d) => true` is hard-coded (not conditional) in the shared HTTP client, plus a second blanket `ServicePointManager.ServerCertificateValidationCallback` override in both UI front-ends | N (GitHub Releases API JSON, unsigned) | **none** — no hash/signature check anywhere in `ComponentUpdaterUIController`/`UpdateChecker` before the downloaded yt-dlp binary replaces the old one and is marked executable | N/A | app/XDM/XDM.Core/Clients/Http/DotNetHttpClient.cs:56 (`ServerCertificateCustomValidationCallback = (a,b,c,d) => true`, unconditional); app/XDM/XDM.Wpf.UI/App.xaml.cs:32 and app/XDM/XDM.Gtk.UI/Program.cs:76 (`ServicePointManager.ServerCertificateValidationCallback += (a,b,c,d) => true`); app/XDM/XDM.Core/Updater/UpdateChecker.cs:205-215 (`FindNewYoutubeDLVersion` via GitHub releases asset); app/XDM/XDM.Core/UI/ComponentUpdaterUIController.cs:120-152 (download → `File.Move` into AppDir, `PlatformHelper.SetExecutable` on Linux, no hash check); app/XDM/XDM.Core/Application.cs:534-536 (app-level update just does `PlatformHelper.OpenBrowser(AppUpdater.UpdatePage)`) |
